    🍲 Mia Bamboo-Smoked Fish¶

    [!INFO] Mia coast — Bamboo-smoked fish in Mountain Bamboo tubes. Smoked fish.

    🥘 Preparation¶

    Human-hand, iron-age: stone grind, wood fire, salt cure, honey preserve, slag-heat bake (3h magnesium slag). No mage-cell food — flavor from herb, not spell. Measured by handful, ledger-weight or agora unit.

    🍽️ Serving¶

    Served at bloc table — daily or feast. Portion by status: hall master gets first cut, children get broth. Festivals double the portion.
